value.name: waits out the forty-eight hours
value.description: The forty-eight-hour period continues to run as Asha waits, having already agreed to the deadline.
evidence: the forty-eight hours kept running the way she had agreed they would.

value.name: reviews the addendum again
value.description: Asha lifts the addendum for a third time, continuing to scrutinize the document.
evidence: After another minute Asha lifted the addendum a third time

value.name: traces Marcus's signature line
value.description: Asha runs her fingertip along the blank line beneath Marcus's printed name, feeling the paper's texture and the printer's fading toner.
evidence: let her fingertip rest on the blank line beneath Marcus's printed name, tracing it once from the left margin to where the toner thinned at the end.
She did not press hard enough to leave a mark on the paper, only enough to feel the slight catch of fiber under her nail where the printer had run dry.

value.name: sets the page back in place
value.description: Asha puts the addendum down on the same spot and aligns its corner carefully with the page beneath it.
evidence: Then she set the page down on its same square of grain and squared the corner with the pad of her thumb until it matched the one beneath.

value.name: leaves the phone face down
value.description: Asha keeps the phone face down beside her, signaling continued waiting and inaction.
evidence: The phone stayed face down beside her.

value.name: realizes no different page will come
value.description: Asha understands that the deadline will not produce any new document beyond the one already in front of her.
evidence: She understood, without saying it to herself in those words, that the forty-eight hours were not going to give her a different page than the one already in front of her.
